# needs it (owner 2026-10-02: explain or fail; never drop content to hit a target). Columns: root label <TAB> metric
# (sections|overflow|growth) <TAB> reason. The label is "fixture" or an ORIENTMAP_EXTRA_ROOTS basename.

column3: The fixture's file names are ~70 B on purpose, so that the 2,048 B overflow cut binds; the twelve group rows then carry 36 such paths (about 2.3 KB). Every byte is a core file name the rule requires; shorter names would test less.
Same cause as the sections row: the long synthetic names, required to bind the overflow cut, are the growth.

+5.5 KB = the sections, 3.2 KB (12 group rows and the 2,048 B overflow: core-file names the rule requires) + their one legend definition, 0.6 KB (served once per session under legend=ref) + the ranked rows, +1.6 KB (the demoted utility sinks' short rows, src/infra/svector.h and kin, give their top-K places to the next-ranked rows, which carry more callees). Dropping any of it cuts a name or a definition the answer needs.

+5.2 KB = the sections, 4.0 KB (12 group rows and the 2,048 B overflow: core-file names the rule requires) + their one legend definition, 0.65 KB (served once per session under legend=ref) + the ranked rows, +0.5 KB (the demoted utility files' places go to the next-ranked rows).

+4.5 KB = the sections, 3.9 KB (12 group rows and the 2,048 B overflow: core-file names the rule requires) + their one legend definition, 0.65 KB (served once per session under legend=ref); the ranked rows are 0.1 KB smaller.
